description: Submit up to 1,000 phone numbers for asynchronous WhatsApp validation. Deducts 1 WA credit PER NUMBER upfront (the whole batch is rejected if the balance is insufficient), so confirm quantities before submitting large batches. Returns a batch_id immediately with status "processing" — retrieve results with whatsapp_batch_status.

phone_numbers.description: Phone numbers to validate (duplicates are removed automatically). Max 1,000.

name: whatsapp_batch_submit
